content.title: Lipocine: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Lipocine Inc. LPCN) on Tuesday reported a loss of $2.2 million in its second quarter. The Salt Lake City-based company said it had a loss of 41 cents per share.

content.title: Lipocine begins dosing in Phase III postpartum depression trial of LPCN 1154
content.summary: Lipocine is expecting to use the data from this trial to support a new drug application submission in mid-2026.

thumbnail.caption: The therapy is expected to be particularly beneficial for those with postpartum depression

content.title: Lipocine: Q1 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Lipocine Inc. LPCN) on Thursday reported a loss of $1.9 million in its first quarter. On a per-share basis, the Salt Lake City-based company said it had a loss of 35 cents.

content.title: Lipocine’s Phase III trial of LPCN 1154 to begin for postpartum depression
content.summary: The trial will compare the therapy against a placebo in women aged 15 years and above who are diagnosed with severe PPD.

thumbnail.caption: The trial aims to assess the efficacy and safety of the therapy in women with postpartum depression. Credit: Arsenii Palivoda/Shutterstock.

content.title: Lipocine: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Lipocine Inc. LPCN) on Thursday reported a loss of $2.2 million in its third quarter. The Salt Lake City-based company said it had a loss of 44 cents per share.

content.title: Lipocine signs supply and distribution agreement with Pharmalink for Tlando
content.summary: Lipocine announced an exclusive supply and distribution agreement with Pharmalink to commercialize Tlando, its oral testosterone replacement therapy, in the Gulf Cooperation Council countries consisting of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman.
